identity.description: Central library symbol SN74LV123ADR promoted from truedepth-shim.

entries.evidence: First-import fit pass: SN74LV123ADR (TI SCLS393Q rev Q, D = SOIC-16 R-PDSO-G16 MS-012 AC, LCSC C134010): pins vision-confirmed on the p3 D top view and the p3 Pin Functions table = symbol 9e4e243a, the L24 council identity-topology glyph (3 designs, 9 judges, winner design-flow-first + grafts; 5 fresh regraders 4/4/3/3/4 on QA pages 599974d4/db37f7d1/ff909866). U1A channel 1: 1 1A-bar, 2 1B, 3 1CLR-bar enter left; 15 1Rext/Cext, 14 1Cext, 13 1Q, 4 1Q-bar leave right. U1B channel 2: 9/10/11 left, 7/6/5/12 right. U1C: 16 VCC, 8 GND. Internals show the Schmitt inputs, the 3-input trigger AND, CLR to the one-shot reset, retriggerable tw = K*RT*CT with K = 1.0 for CT >= 1000 pF (p15), so U13 (A = GND, B rising edge, CLR high: p13 Table 1 row 4) reads left to right. Pin facts 49/49 qualified single-printing (guide 73a461c0); the p3 table function conditions carry the TI erratum noted in f-38e5a4, not adopted as behaviour. Land = stock Package_SO:SOIC-16_3.9x9.9mm_P1.27mm (sha f9b50757) with its stock SOIC-16 STEP (d5eeddb4), named by the Footprint field; it fits p24 D 4040047 (e 1.27, pads 1-8 / 9-16 CCW, pad 1.95 x 0.6 vs b 0.31-0.51, toe +0.35 past the max tip, courtyard 7.4 x 10.4).
